It is hard to believe that it’s been 16 years since we filmed the first Postmodern Jukebox video in a Queens, NY basement. Many of you likely remember finding us on here during the halcyon “viral” years of 2013-15 — back when a jazz cover of a pop song could stop the internet cold.

Our mission was never about pleasing an algorithm, though. It was to build something that would outlast the algorithms, rooted in the belief that great music performed by extraordinary talent is truly timeless, belonging to all eras.  

Slowly but surely over the past decade, we’ve continued to build the PMJ Universe of alternate timeline covers, while highlighting some of the “Old Soul” performers of today who are most deserving of the spotlight.
